description: Search US National Science Foundation funded research awards by keyword, recipient institution name, US state, CFDA program number, and award date range. Returns award ID, title, awardee, principal investigator, dates, funding amount, program, and an abstract excerpt for each match. Data: api.nsf.gov (National Science Foundation), no auth required.

awardeeName.description: Filter by recipient institution name substring (e.g. "Stanford", "MIT").

awardeeStateCode.description: Filter by recipient institution US state code, 2 letters (e.g. "CA", "NY").

cfdaNumber.description: Filter by CFDA program number (e.g. "47.070" for Computer and Information Science).

dateEnd.description: Only awards made on/before this date, format MM/DD/YYYY.

dateStart.description: Only awards made on/after this date, format MM/DD/YYYY.

keyword.description: Full-text search term matched against award title/abstract (e.g. "climate", "quantum computing").

name: nsf-awards.grants.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search NSF Research Awards
